name: After § 43
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 43d. Calls on Parliament to ensure, across all its outsourced service contracts, that changes of contractor do not result in a deterioration of employment conditions, unjustified loss of seniority or disruption to the professional continuity of the workers concerned; calls for tender documents to provide for effective social safeguards and for compliance with those safeguards to be monitored throughout the duration of the contract.
